pages.title: Learning Materials
pages.text: Under Knowledge Level, add a book, manuscript, or bottle o' enchanting and select Learn. Manuscripts teach more than books; bottles teach a little more than manuscripts.

pages.title: Knowledge Level One
pages.text: Knowledge begins at level zero. At 300 accumulated knowledge XP, it automatically reaches $(bold)level one$(); no enchanted book is needed.$(br2)Give the dragon a name and wait for growth stage three, and it can attempt its $(l:dragonmaid:forms/transformation)first transformation$(/l).

pages.title: Knowledge Level Two
pages.text: At 1,000 accumulated knowledge, add a non-cursed enchanted book and select Advance. $(bold)Knowledge level two$() unlocks the second accessory slot.$(br2)Advancing consumes the book, but does not spend knowledge.

pages.title: Enchanted Book Learning
pages.text: At knowledge level one, non-cursed enchanted books can be placed in the learning slot. At level two, cursed books can be read too. More enchantments and higher levels usually bring more knowledge.$(br2)Learning and advancement use separate slots. Knowledge beyond the next goal is kept.

pages.title: Using Wooden Doors
pages.text: At knowledge level two, a human-form companion can open and close wooden doors. If one leaf is too narrow and there is room, it can open both.$(br2)Leave room for its height and width; if it cannot fit, it will try another route.

pages.title: Knowledge Level Three
pages.text: After level two, keep learning until 2,500 knowledge. Place two non-cursed enchanted books and one cursed enchanted book in their separate slots.$(br2)Advancing to level three unlocks the third accessory slot; knowledge is retained.

pages.title: Books for Advancement
pages.text: Non-cursed books need enchantments and no curse. Cursed books go in the cursed slot; normal books do not count.$(br2)Any valid enchantment or level works; books can be identical. Each book counts once, even with several enchantments. Effects do not transfer.

pages.title: Progression and Limits
pages.text: Reach 1,000 knowledge for level two, then 2,500 for level three. You can advance only one level at a time, so prepare the books for each step in order.$(br2)Level three is the current limit. The new slots let you adjust your $(l:dragonmaid:accessories/companions)accessory combination$(/l).

pages.title: Knowledge and Growth
pages.text: Growth and knowledge are separate. Levels two and three do not require growth stages four or five. The $(l:dragonmaid:forms/transformation)first transformation$(/l) still needs a name, stage three, and knowledge level one (300 total XP).$(br2)Extra dragon storage and other future features are not available yet.
